value.rationale: A single missing bond is a natural fault operation on a dense, symmetric two-population interaction network. The result distinguishes three qualitatively opposite responses—destruction of all nonzero recurrence, creation of genuine two-cycles, and creation of order-six recurrence—and supplies exact entry-time and per-orbit basin statistics over an infinite family, including every finite characteristic-two field. The claim answers a structural network sensitivity question rather than restating a generic matrix fact or an isolated small calculation.
